We need to determine number of C=O groups in the compound. We have no SMILES given. We need to get IR spectra maybe to see carbonyl stretch. Or carbon NMR? But easiest is to get IR spectra which shows C=O stretch around 1700 cm-1. However we need count. Could also use carbon NMR to see carbonyl carbons (~190-210 ppm). But we need the compound identity? Not given. We need to measure IR to see number of carbonyl peaks. Could also use HSQC? Probably IR is enough.

We should call ir_spectra tool.
